//: Thirdlight strict base config (dependencies.md §5 check 5: strict: true, TypeScript 5.9.3 pinned; decision 0001 §2/§3). Per-package tsconfigs extend this file and are typechecked with `tsc --noEmit` (root `npm run typecheck`). jsx: react-jsx enables typechecking the editor's TSX (decision 0001 §10: React editor UI; esbuild's TSX loader builds it — no separate TSX tooling). Browser libs are in the base lib set because the browser packages (editor, three-adapter, runtime) are the majority; Node-side packages may narrow/extend `lib` and `types` in their own tsconfig.
